newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks end the year firmer.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks end the year firmer.

text.p: Croatian stocks ended the year mostly higher in brisker trade on Tuesday.
* Five of eight active issues rose, two fell and one was flat.
* Volume up at 5,142 shares, turnover doubled to 7.6 million kuna. Full results available on page ZAGSTOCK.
* Top gainer cable maker Elka jumped 55 kuna to close at 195, selling 18 shares.
* Biggest decliner hotelier Jadranturist lost 15 kuna to 220, with 124 shares sold.
* Most active Zagrebacka Banka lost 20 kuna to close at 1,060 on volume of 3,676 shares. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
